# Chandigarh municipal election records

*Generated by `make state-readmes`.*

Official records for the 2006 council cohort, 2011, 2016 and 2021. These urban supplemental tables are separate from the rural pooled master.

| File | Rows |
| --- | ---: |
| [winners.parquet](release/winners.parquet) | 87 |
| [candidates_2011.parquet](release/candidates_2011.parquet) | 152 |
| [candidate_counts_2011.parquet](release/candidate_counts_2011.parquet) | 26 |
| [ward_panel_2006_2011.parquet](release/ward_panel_2006_2011.parquet) | 26 |
| [ward_panel_2011_2016.parquet](release/ward_panel_2011_2016.parquet) | 26 |

The 2006–2011 ward link is supported by an official unchanged-boundary notification. The 2011 winner-sex field comes from printed candidate honorifics checked against gender totals, independently of seat reservation. Later by-elections and deferred polls are distinguished from the general election.

See the [source review](source_review.md), [dictionary](release/dictionary.csv), and [source and output hashes](release/manifest.json) for definitions, coverage and unresolved fields.

The 2016 extension retains all 26 wards and separate source-title outcomes. All 17 later nonquota wards have male-title winners; earlier 2006 exposure and the 2016 assignment reset remain explicit. Its [manifest](release/ward_panel_2011_2016_manifest.json) pins the additional sources and metadata.

Run `make chandigarh` to rebuild offline and `pytest tests/test_chandigarh.py tests/test_chandigarh_extension.py -q` for the affected checks.
